questions.question: What is total revenue?
questions.sql: SELECT round(sum(revenue), 2) AS total_revenue FROM sales_clean

questions.question: What is revenue by region?
questions.sql: SELECT region, round(sum(revenue), 2) AS revenue FROM sales_clean GROUP BY region ORDER BY revenue DESC, region

questions.question: What is revenue by category?
questions.sql: SELECT category, round(sum(revenue), 2) AS revenue FROM sales_clean GROUP BY category ORDER BY revenue DESC, category

questions.question: What is revenue by segment?
questions.sql: SELECT segment, round(sum(revenue), 2) AS revenue FROM sales_clean GROUP BY segment ORDER BY revenue DESC, segment

questions.question: How many sales lines are there?
questions.sql: SELECT count(*) AS row_count FROM sales_clean

questions.question: How many distinct customers are there?
questions.sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT customer_id) AS customers FROM sales_clean

questions.question: How many distinct products are there?
questions.sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT product_id) AS products FROM sales_clean

questions.question: What is the first and last order date?
questions.sql: SELECT min(order_date)::text AS first_order, max(order_date)::text AS last_order FROM sales_clean

questions.question: What is revenue in 2017?
questions.sql: SELECT extract(year FROM order_date)::int AS year, round(sum(revenue), 2) AS revenue FROM sales_clean WHERE extract(year FROM order_date) = 2017 GROUP BY 1

questions.question: What is revenue in 2018?
questions.sql: SELECT extract(year FROM order_date)::int AS year, round(sum(revenue), 2) AS revenue FROM sales_clean WHERE extract(year FROM order_date) = 2018 GROUP BY 1

questions.question: Who are the top 5 customers by revenue?
questions.sql: SELECT customer_id, round(sum(revenue), 2) AS revenue FROM sales_clean GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY revenue DESC, customer_id LIMIT 5

questions.question: What are the top 5 sub-categories by revenue?
questions.sql: SELECT sub_category, round(sum(revenue), 2) AS revenue FROM sales_clean GROUP BY sub_category ORDER BY revenue DESC, sub_category LIMIT 5

questions.question: What is Furniture revenue?
questions.sql: SELECT round(sum(revenue), 2) AS revenue FROM sales_clean WHERE category = 'Furniture'

questions.question: What percentage of revenue comes from the Consumer segment?
questions.sql: SELECT round(100 * sum(revenue) FILTER (WHERE segment = 'Consumer') / sum(revenue), 2) AS consumer_pct FROM sales_clean

questions.question: What is revenue in the South?
questions.sql: SELECT round(sum(revenue), 2) AS revenue FROM sales_clean WHERE region = 'South'

questions.question: Which category has the highest revenue?
questions.sql: SELECT category, round(sum(revenue), 2) AS revenue FROM sales_clean GROUP BY category ORDER BY revenue DESC, category LIMIT 1

questions.question: What is revenue by year?
questions.sql: SELECT extract(year FROM order_date)::int AS year, round(sum(revenue), 2) AS revenue FROM sales_clean GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

questions.question: What is Office Supplies revenue in the West?
questions.sql: SELECT round(sum(revenue), 2) AS revenue FROM sales_clean WHERE category = 'Office Supplies' AND region = 'West'

questions.question: How many sub-categories are there?
questions.sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT sub_category) AS sub_categories FROM sales_clean

questions.question: What is the average revenue per line?
questions.sql: SELECT round(avg(revenue), 2) AS avg_revenue FROM sales_clean
